name: Vedetta Crypto Desk
description: Solana rail of the Vedetta pay-per-call market intelligence API — free /sol/v1/track-record + 22 x402-paid endpoints ($0.01 cached, $0.05 live) settled in USDC on Solana (scheme exact, SVM) under /sol/v1/*. Payment is authentication. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

free_endpoints.description: FREE (rate-limited 20/min/IP) — Verifiable analyst call log and transparency stats (?asset=BTC optional): every signal this desk has published, timestamped and countable, plus total paid calls served (excludes /v1/route). No wallet/x402. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

params.asset: STRING — one ticker to filter the log (OPTIONAL; omit for all-asset stats)

next_paid_steps.why: Cached signal + staleness for one asset
Cached signal time-series for backtests / trend context
Cross-asset divergence scan — pick what to research next
Live sentiment-vs-price verdict when snapshot is stale
Live multi-factor desk synthesis for a free-form question

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — ask
services.description: Ask a live crypto, stock, or macro analyst desk any market question — social sentiment, dominant narrative, Polymarket & Kalshi prediction-market odds, sentiment-vs-price divergence, whale positioning and funding context — answered fresh in 10-180s. ?q= free-form and/or ?asset=BTC. A live specialist desk at generic-AI-research prices. No charge if the desk fails to answer. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — consensus
services.description: Sentiment-vs-price divergence verdict for any crypto asset (BTC, ETH, SOL, SUI, HYPE, DOGE, XRP...): bullish/bearish/neutral verdict with confidence, live price, crowd sentiment %, prediction-market odds and dominant narrative. The contrarian alpha signal raw data APIs don't sell. Upgrade here when /v1/snapshot shows stale=true. Stale cache triggers a live analyst refresh inside the call (10-90s). Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — equity
services.description: Sentiment-vs-price divergence read on a US STOCK or equity ticker (?asset=NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, COIN, MSTR, PLTR, AMD, META): social sentiment %, dominant narrative, prediction-market context and divergence from price action — a live analyst verdict on equities and earnings sentiment, not raw SEC filings. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — macro
services.description: Live analyst read on a MACRO instrument — equity indices, treasury yields, volatility, commodities (?asset=SPX, VIX, US10Y, US2Y, GOLD, OIL, BRENT): crowd sentiment %, dominant FOMC/CPI/rates narrative and divergence vs price action. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — prediction
services.description: A falsifiable analyst prediction and price forecast for one asset (?asset=BTC&horizon=7d): the explicit claim, confidence %, invalidation criteria (what proves it wrong), and prediction-market anchoring. Pair with /v1/track-record or /v1/korra/calls to audit how past calls resolved — accountable machine predictions for trading agents. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — pulse
services.description: Market-wide crypto regime read in one live call: overall sentiment score, bull/bear/chop regime id, SPX/macro anchor and the top narrative driving the entire crypto market right now. Live analyst desk read, never a stale aggregate. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — theme
services.description: Deep-dive on a tracked market theme or sector rotation (?theme=ai-sentiment-divergence, altcoin-decoupling, macro-risk-off, regulatory-pressure, tradfi-adoption, rwa, meme-supercycle, or free text): whether the narrative is strengthening or fading, which tickers it moves, and the desk's conviction. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — trend
services.description: Price-vs-sentiment momentum trajectory for one asset over a time window (?asset=BTC&window=7d): how tape and crowd sentiment moved together or diverged over 24h/7d/30d, and whether momentum is strengthening or fading. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — news-read
services.description: Breaking market-moving news read and catalyst analysis for one asset (?asset=BTC): what just happened, why it matters for price action, and the crowd sentiment read on the catalyst — analyzed by a live desk, not a raw RSS headline feed. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — house-view
services.description: The analyst desk's current high-conviction thesis and house view on one crypto asset — tracked insight threads, thesis status (strengthening/weakening) and confidence score (?asset=BTC). Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — event
services.description: Live catalyst & anomaly trigger probe on an asset (?asset=BTC): checks for significant real-time triggers — price_gap, news_shock, or social_spike — with a 1-10 significance score, or a clean no-event answer. Built for autonomous agent monitoring loops that escalate after polling /v1/feed or /v1/korra/news. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — odds
services.description: Live prediction-market odds (Polymarket, Kalshi, event contracts) for one crypto asset — nearest liquid market, implied probability %, venue — plus whether prediction-market odds agree or diverge from current social sentiment (?asset=BTC). Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — social
services.description: Live social sentiment and crowd positioning read for one crypto asset (?asset=BTC): bullish %, social engagement score, and social volume trend vs baseline — fresh from the analyst desk. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — narrative
services.description: Dominant market narrative on one crypto asset and 24h narrative-rotation detection (?asset=BTC): identifies what the crowd is talking about right now and whether the primary story rotated in the last 24h. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — screener
services.description: Screen crypto assets for sentiment-vs-price divergence in one cached call (?only=divergent): sentiment %, stance, divergence_flagged, signal age — pick what to research first. Cached $0.01; upgrade hits to /v1/consensus or /v1/ask ($0.05) for live multi-factor desk synthesis. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — history
services.description: Fetch historical sentiment time-series for one asset (?asset=BTC&limit=50): timestamped sentiment %, stance, divergence flags, narratives — $0.01 cached backtest fodder. Chain to /v1/screener ($0.01) or live /v1/consensus|/v1/ask ($0.05) for multi-factor synthesis. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — feed
services.description: Recent analyst desk posts as a fast JSON stream (?since_id=&asset=&limit=): cached, instant. $0.01 USDC x402. Poll to detect moves, then escalate to a $0.05 live read (/v1/event, /v1/consensus, /v1/ask). Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — snapshot
services.description: Latest cached analyst signal for one asset (?asset=BTC): sentiment %, stance, divergence flag, narrative, signal_age_minutes and stale boolean. $0.01 USDC x402. When stale=true or before executing, upgrade to paid /v1/consensus ($0.05). Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — route
services.description: $0.01 USDC x402 — Autonomous agent task router: describe what you need in plain English (?task=...) and get the exact Vedetta endpoint, parameters, ready-to-call URL and USD price — plus cheaper alternates. Instant local matching, never fires a live analyst read. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — calls
services.description: $0.01 USDC x402 — Korra open calls + recent hit/miss results (?asset=BTC optional). open_calls redacted (pay $0.01 via /v1/feed|/snapshot for thesis). Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — news
services.description: $0.01 USDC x402 — Korra scored news stories window (?asset=BTC optional). Proxied partner JSON as-is. Descriptive research, not financial advice.

services.name: Vedetta Crypto Desk — lean
services.description: $0.01 USDC x402 — Korra lean gauge readings (?asset=BTC optional). FEAR_GREED full; other gauges teaser + $0.01 unlock CTA. Descriptive research, not financial advice.
